_comment: An example subset of the full label extent (~3.4k h): reazon_large's first 216 of 705 inputs (~1,501 h), galgame's first 16 of 115 tars (~744 h), emilia_yodas whole (~1,084 h) and reazon_small (~100 h). Its label files are a subset of configs/full.json's (the same extent root; kitsune/extent.py within), so it needs no labelling: the A100 rebuilds only this prefix of the canonical ingest sequence and pulls only its stems, and its selection is derived from the full one (python scripts/make_selection.py --config configs/full_sub3k.json --from-selection labels/full/selections/full.parquet). The trainer sections inherit DEFAULTS; the A100 training recipe is decided in the A100 plan.
